image_description: A light blue, satin-like cloth diaper or nappy cover lying flat on a neutral beige surface. It features prominent white lace trim along the leg openings and waistband. The material appears shiny and smooth, suggesting a synthetic blend rather than traditional cotton. There are no visible adhesive tabs, indicating it may be a pull-on style or the back is facing up.
